title: 2 Kings Bible Quiz - Chapter 10
description: Ten questions on 2 Kings 10: Jehu destroys Ahab's house and the worshipers of Baal, yet keeps to the sins of Jeroboam.

questions.text: How many sons did Ahab have in Samaria?
questions.explanation: The chapter begins by saying that Ahab had seventy sons in Samaria.

answers.text: Twelve
Thirty
Seventy
Forty

questions.text: Why were those who received Jehu's first letter exceedingly afraid?
questions.explanation: They said, 'Behold, the two kings didn't stand before him! How then shall we stand?'

answers.text: The two kings had not stood before him
Elisha had foretold their destruction
Jehu had a greater army than theirs
Their city had no walls or gates

questions.text: In what did the great men of the city send the heads of the king's sons to Jehu?
questions.explanation: They killed the king's sons, put their heads in baskets and sent them to Jehu in Jezreel.

answers.text: In sacks
In chests
On spears
In baskets

questions.text: Whom did Jehu meet at the shearing house of the shepherds?
questions.explanation: At the shearing house Jehu met the brothers of Ahaziah king of Judah, who were going down to greet the king's children.

answers.text: The prophets of Baal from Samaria
The brothers of Ahaziah king of Judah
The elders of the city of Jezreel
The servants of Hazael king of Syria

questions.text: Whom did Jehu take up into his chariot after he gave him his hand?
questions.explanation: Jehu met Jehonadab the son of Rechab, asked if his heart was right, and when he gave him his hand, took him up into the chariot.

answers.text: Jehonadab the son of Rechab
Bidkar his captain
Elisha the prophet
Jehoahaz his son

questions.text: What did Jehu say to all the people about serving Baal?
questions.explanation: Jehu gathered the people and said, 'Ahab served Baal a little; but Jehu will serve him much,' though he did it deceptively.

answers.text: Whoever serves Baal among you shall surely die.
Let Baal plead for himself against us today.
Ahab served Baal a little; but Jehu will serve him much.
Go back to your tents and serve Yahweh alone.

questions.text: What did Jehu tell the keeper of the wardrobe to bring out?
questions.explanation: Jehu said to him who kept the wardrobe, 'Bring out robes for all the worshipers of Baal!'

answers.text: The vessels of the house of Baal
Swords for the guard and captains
Oil and incense for the sacrifice
Robes for all the worshipers of Baal

questions.text: What did they make of the house of Baal after they broke it down?
questions.explanation: They broke down the pillar of Baal and the house of Baal, and made it a latrine, to this day.

answers.text: A stable
A latrine
A storehouse
A prison

questions.text: Which sins of Jeroboam did Jehu not depart from?
questions.explanation: Jehu did not depart from the sins of Jeroboam, the golden calves that were in Bethel and that were in Dan.

answers.text: The high places in Gilgal and Shiloh
The groves in Samaria and in Jezreel
The golden calves in Bethel and in Dan
The idols in Hebron and in Beersheba

questions.text: What did Yahweh promise Jehu's descendants?
questions.explanation: Yahweh said that because Jehu had done well, his descendants would sit on the throne of Israel to the fourth generation.

answers.text: To sit on the throne of Israel to the fourth generation
To rule over Judah and Israel together forever
To defeat Hazael king of Syria in every battle
To build a house for Yahweh's name in Samaria
